messages:
deploy-bot: Build 3.2.1-rc.3 created for service/inference (sha: b7f6c9a). artifact: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/3.2.1-rc.3 :tada:
ashley: preparing origination + signoff. pinned artifact is 3.2.1-rc.3, confirm no late-change exceptions? :eyes:
tom: KV warm plan looks good. need a ~10m warm window before canary traffic. I'll schedule kv-warm job at T+15m.
jordan: canary routing: start with 1% traffic to region-us-west on Dedicated pool A, then 5% after 10m if errors & latency stable. fallback to model-3.1-quant if token errors spike.
qa-radar: quick smoke on staging passed: 50/50 prompt set, no regression vs baseline (latency median +2ms). found one flaky rerank test (item #43) — not blocking for rollout but added to ticket INF-2241.
ashley: thanks. two asks: (1) confirm release notes link and notable user-impacting changes; (2) final rollback thresholds we will enforce automatically.
maria: release notes draft here: https://docs.redwood.example/release-notes/3.2.1-rc.3 — highlights: improved kv cache reclaiming, attention-fusion kernel opt, minor iface change in /v1/embeddings (backwards compatible).
sheriff: set rollback policy: immediate rollback if 5m error rate > 0.5% OR p50 latency increase > 300ms over baseline OR request CPU > 85% for 3 consecutive minutes. also manual abort if data-plane 5xxs spike even under thresholds.
tom: noted. I'll put an ops watch on those metrics and wire alert runbook. runbook summary in thread: ```
Rollback triggers:
- 5m error_rate > 0.5% -> auto rollback
- p50_latency delta > +300ms -> auto rollback
- host_cpu > 85% x 3m -> auto rollback
- manual abort -> oncall-sheriff decision
```
ashley: can someone call out the pinned docker tag and helm image? we should not allow auto-promote to pick a different minor build.
deploy-bot: artifact pinned -> docker.redwood/inference:3.2.1-rc.3, helm chart release: inference-3.2.1-rc3.tgz (pin applied to release manifest).
jordan: scheduling: kv-warm + canary 1% at T+15m, metrics check at T+25m, ramp to 5% at T+30m if green, 25% at T+60m, full at T+120m. rollback window until T+150m.
qa-radar: adding a short smoke checklist for post-promote: 10 quick tokens, 5 embedding checks, rerank canonical prompts. Will post pass/fail in here once done.
sheriff: i'm +1 for promote if QA signs off and no pre-existing infra alerts. if anything smells, i'll hold.
ashley: final signoff: @qa-radar mark smoke done, @sheriff final ack, then i'll call /promote.
qa-radar: smoke checks passed at T+28m. small latency blip at minute 3 of canary but within thresholds. logs: ``ERROR 0 of 200 sampled had rerank anomaly`` -> non-blocking.
sheriff: ack and standing by.
ashley: /promote inference 3.2.1-rc.3 -> production

deploy-bot: Promotion started: rolling canary -> prod. tracking run id: promo-20260320-rl-88. details: https://ci.redwood.example/promotions/promo-20260320-rl-88
ashley: monitoring console: https://console.redwood.example/dashboards/inference/promotions/promo-20260320-rl-88 — watch latency/error charts.
tom: ops watch live. alert thresholds armed.
maria: posting final release notes link to #announcements after full promotion.
deploy-bot: Promotion step: canary 1% -> success. ramping to 5%.
jordan: 5% good at T+38m. no new 5xx, p50 delta +7ms.
deploy-bot: ramp to 25% -> success.
qa-radar: post-25% smoke ok. embedding vectors stable.
deploy-bot: ramp to 100% -> success. promotion complete.
sheriff: no regressions observed, marking promo as green.
ashley: thanks team. postmortem prep: note the rerank flaky test in INF-2241; not blocking for this release but follow-up required. I'll create ticket to track. :white_check_mark:
maria: announcement drafted and scheduled for 10:05 UTC.
ashley: closing thread. if any anomalies surface in next 24h ping this thread and we'll consider rolling back or hotfix. :shipit:
